PM Modi visits New Zealand, discusses bilateral ties

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has visited New Zealand, engaging in discussions aimed at strengthening bilateral relations between the two countries. During his visit, he highlighted the shared journey and opportunities between India and New Zealand, using the metaphor of a 'waka' to symbolize their cooperation. The visit underscores efforts to deepen diplomatic and economic ties.
